results.alertTitle: AWS console sign-in by bob.jones from an external address

summary.tpReason: CloudTrail records a successful IAM-user ConsoleLogin for bob.jones at 17:22:50Z with MFA, so an authentication event exists in the ingested data. However, its purported client IP is a non-routable documentation address, strongly indicating synthetic/test telemetry rather than a real hostile external login.
summary.fpReason: 203.0.113.50 is within TEST-NET-3, reserved for documentation and not meant to appear on the public Internet (IETF RFC 5737). The surrounding AWS records also use TEST-NET addresses (198.51.100.x) and a lab-style account number, consistent with an injected SentinelLab scenario. The rule labeled this reserved address as external without excluding documentation ranges.
summary.whatHappened: AWSCloudTrail records IAM user arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/bob.jones from 203.0.113.50. At 2026-08-19 17:22:50.057Z it logged a successful ConsoleLogin to https://console.aws.amazon.com from a macOS browser; MFAUsed=Yes and SessionMfaAuthenticated=true. The same synthetic source/user made four successful read-only CLI calls before the login (DescribeSecurityGroups 17:01:10Z, GetBucketAcl for corp-data-prod 17:02:05Z, DescribeInstanceStatus 17:11:05Z, GetBucketLogging for corp-data-prod 17:17:35Z). No subsequent Bob/source events exist. This is almost certainly lab/example data, not a real externally sourced AWS session.
keyEvidence: CloudTrail ConsoleLogin at 2026-08-19T17:22:50.057Z for bob.jones from 203.0.113.50 returned ConsoleLogin=Success; AdditionalEventData reports MFAUsed=Yes and the session MFA field is true.
203.0.113.50 belongs to 203.0.113.0/24 (TEST-NET-3). RFC 5737 states this block is for documentation and SHOULD NOT appear on the public Internet: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5737
The same Bob/source pair had only four preceding successful read-only AWS CLI discovery calls; no CloudTrail event for either identity or source was found after the console login.
The 16:45–17:25Z AWS activity contains several other TEST-NET-2/3 sources (198.51.100.x and 203.0.113.x), supporting a synthetic exercise dataset rather than a real external-address pattern.
researchDone: Retrieved AWSCloudTrail, SecurityAlert, and AuditLogsHunting_CL schemas; AWSCloudTrail was the relevant source for this AWS alert.
Queried all Bob/source CloudTrail events from 2026-08-18 through 2026-08-21 and reviewed identity, result, MFA, agent, request, and resource fields.
Queried 31 days of Bob history: only five events were present, all on 2026-08-19 from 203.0.113.50; no historical legitimate baseline IP was available.
Queried events after 2026-08-19T17:22:50.057Z for Bob's username/ARN and 203.0.113.50; none returned.
Reviewed co-timed AWS activity and related alerts; multiple accounts used documentation IP ranges. Consulted IETF RFC 5737 for the reserved-address classification.
